description: This file defines the 'Mapping' class, a configuration schema element in Drupal, handling nested properties, dynamic keys, and validation logic for configuration mappings.

classes.name: Mapping
classes.description: Defines a mapping configuration element for Drupal's configuration schema, supporting nested properties, dynamic keys, and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that validates the mapping definition and processes required key flags.

methods.name: getElementDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the data definition for a specific key in the mapping.

methods.name: getValidKeys
methods.description: Returns all allowed keys in this mapping.

methods.name: getRequiredKeys
methods.description: Returns all required keys in this mapping.

methods.name: getDefinedKeys
methods.description: Returns all keys defined for this mapping, including inherited ones.

methods.name: getDynamicallyValidKeys
methods.description: Returns keys that are valid dynamically based on the mapping's context and type.

methods.name: getOptionalKeys
methods.description: Returns keys that are optional in this mapping.

methods.name: processRequiredKeyFlags
methods.description: Validates and sets the 'requiredKey' flags for mapping keys.

methods.name: getPossibleTypes
methods.description: Returns all possible types for a given mapping type name, considering dynamic placeholders and fallbacks.
